description_en:
Retrieves the details of a standard.
Release version: v5.4.2
description_zh:
获取标准详情。
上线版本：v5.4.2
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public get-standard --op-tenant-id 30001011 --standard-get-query StandardStage=dev Version=1 StandardId=1234 NeedRelation=true Nullable=true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetStandard

fields.description_en: Specifies whether to return a null value when the standard does not exist. If set to false, an exception is thrown. Default value: true.
fields.description_zh: 标准不存在时是否允许返回空值, 如果为false则会抛出异常，默认：true
fields.help_en: Specifies whether to return a null value when the standard does not exist. If set to false, an exception is thrown. Default value: true
fields.help_zh: 标准不存在时是否允许返回空值, 如果为false则会抛出异常，默认：true
fields.name: nullable

fields.description_en: The version number. If left empty, the latest version is used.
fields.description_zh: 版本号, 为空表示最新版本
fields.help_en: The version number. If left empty, the latest version is used
fields.help_zh: 版本号, 为空表示最新版本
fields.name: version

fields.description_en:
The stage to which the standard belongs. Valid values:
- dev: development stage.
- prod: production stage.

Default value: prod.
fields.help_en:
The stage to which the standard belongs. Valid values:
- dev: development stage.
- prod: production stage.

Default value: prod
fields.name: standard_stage

fields.description_en: Specifies whether to return associated standards and associated lookup tables. Default value: false.
fields.description_zh: 是否需要返回关联标准和关联码表, 默认：false
fields.help_en: Specifies whether to return associated standards and associated lookup tables. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否需要返回关联标准和关联码表, 默认：false
